title: Who supplies money, collateral and loss protection
shared: These studies trace funding, collateral, obligations and loss through a transaction. Read them together to distinguish the party supplying cash from the party holding collateral, owing repayment or bearing a default loss.
keep_distinct: Keep the FICC service, cash investor, sponsor, BNY custody, Fed proposal and each transaction separate. Shared branding or custody does not prove an XRP-funded repo or connect an unproved XRP claim to an operating transaction.

tools.title: Settlement Language Lab
tools.why: Compare settlement language while keeping the obligation, record, discharge and failure questions distinct.
